card.name: Words before cycle, chain, or inertia nouns
card.fires_on: Small words like 'the', 'a', 'for' or verbs like 'break' that come just before an expected noun about cycles, chains, inertia or long duration. Found in general web text on policy, economy and social issues.

modes.label: Break the cycle
modes.description: Verb or 'the' right before 'cycle of poverty'.
modes.example: we're also building a stronger economy to help<< break>> the cycle of poverty.

modes.label: Linking word before an abstract noun
modes.description: A small word before a noun about lasting effects, links or histories.
modes.example: Neuroticism seems to have<< a>> direct link to cases of severe panic disorders

modes.label: Duration or ongoing effect
modes.description: A word before a phrase about long-lasting persistence.
modes.example: which remains in the atmosphere<< for>> more than a century.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward word starts like 'gener' and 'cyc', as in generations and cycle, and away from unrelated name or structure pieces.
card.plain: It fires on little words just before a phrase about a cycle, chain of events, or something lasting for generations.
